articles.title: GST collections surge to record high of Rs 2.43 lakh cr in April
articles.summary: India's Gross GST collection hit a record Rs 2.43 lakh crore in April, marking an 8.7% increase compared to the previous year. This substantial growth was primarily fuelled by a significant rise in import-led revenues, which outpaced domestic transactions. This robust collection reflects healthy economic activity and strengthens the government's financial resources, crucial for national development.
